stringclaw 0.0.9 streamlines setup instructions:

- Simplified and updated setup steps using new openclaw config commands for gateway and authentication.
- Rewrote agent creation instructions to use a one-line CLI command.
- Combined troubleshooting and requirements for easier reference.
- Clarified guidance for reading tokens and handling call errors.
- Enhanced description and output/error documentation for greater clarity.
